newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Aug housing completions fell 1.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Aug housing completions fell 1.9 pct.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Department report on completions of new privately-owned housing units, seasonally adjusted annual rates, in 1,000s, with percent changes from prior months and year over year.
Housing completions by region, seasonally adj., in 1,000s:

Completions of single-family homes fell 1.3 percent in August after July was revised to a 1.2 percent rise, and June revised to a 0.7 percent increase. Previously, the department said single-family completions fell 0.4 percent in July and rose 0.2 percent in June.

August multi-family unit completions fell 4.3 percent after a revised 5.2 percent rise in July and a revised 0.7 percent increase in June. July was revised from a 7.2 percent rise and June from a 1.0 percent increase.

The department said actual completions on an unadjusted basis rose in August to 129,000 units from 126,100 units in July and were also up from 125,900 units in June. In August last year, actual completions were reported at 115,500.

Privately-owned housing units under construction rose to a seasonally adjusted 827,000 in August from 826,000 in July, but were off from 829,000 in June. They compare with 772,000 units under construction in August last year.
